purpose: Chinese quality documentation design review; explicit quality and release evaluations with reasons and supporting evidence; fictional data, not application screenshots

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a clean, simple Chinese NocoBase Studio desktop UI design mockup, landscape 1600x1080. Straight-on crisp flat screenshot, no browser frame or device. White sidebar 205px, white header, very light gray main canvas, restrained cobalt blue accents, thin gray panel borders, dark Chinese sans-serif typography, spacious layout. Chinese text must be sharp and accurate. No gradients or decorative graphics. NocoBase wordmark top left. Sidebar: 我的任务, 我的会话, section 开发 with 任务, 质量 (blue active), 项目, 知识库; footer NocoBase Studio. This is a proposed product design; small footer 设计示意 · 示例数据. Match native Studio visual language. Do not add manual start-test buttons, create-plan buttons, fake health percentages, or analytics graphs.
Primary request: the DEFAULT Quality page when “全部项目” is selected, showing only projects the user can access, with BOTH overall quality and release readiness clearly visible per project.
Top breadcrumb “质量”.
Main heading “质量”. Under heading “了解各项目的整体质量与发布就绪情况”.
Top-right project selector visibly reads “全部项目” with a chevron.
Below a simple toolbar: search field placeholder “搜索项目”, small filter “全部状态”.
One wide white table panel. Headers “项目”, “整体质量”, “发布质量”, “测试动态”, “最近更新”.
Four large readable rows:
1 project “Studio”, secondary “负责人 杨洽”; overall red label “存在风险”, secondary “5 项待处理问题，1 项高风险”; release orange label “4 项阻碍发布”; testing blue label “1 个任务测试中”; updated “5 分钟前”; subtle right chevron.
2 project “供应商管理”, secondary “负责人 陈晓”; overall green “未发现问题”; release green “已满足发布要求”; testing “最近验证通过”; updated “10 分钟前”; chevron.
3 project “NocoBase 3”, secondary “负责人 李明”; overall blue “验证中”; release amber “2 项待验证”; testing blue “2 个任务测试中”; updated “18 分钟前”; chevron.
4 project “客户中心”, secondary “负责人 王宁”; overall gray “尚未验证”; release gray “尚未评估”; testing gray “等待首个可测任务”; updated “—”; chevron.
Use green/red/blue/amber dots and pale badges sparingly. Project names bold, their titles clickable blue or dark. Lots of breathing room, no compressed columns. At bottom of the table show “4 个项目” and subtle text “仅显示你有权限的项目”.
Below the table a small unobtrusive hint “选择项目，查看质量看板、测试任务和问题进展。”
Leave appropriate white space, no additional invented controls. The “全部项目” selector, project list, overall-quality column, and release-quality column must be visually obvious.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a clean, simple Chinese NocoBase Studio desktop UI design mockup, landscape 1600x1080. Straight-on crisp flat screenshot, no browser frame or device. White sidebar 205px, white header, very light gray main canvas, restrained cobalt blue accents, thin gray panel borders, dark Chinese sans-serif typography, spacious layout. Chinese text must be sharp and accurate. No gradients or decorative graphics. NocoBase wordmark top left. Sidebar: 我的任务, 我的会话, section 开发 with 任务, 质量 (blue active), 项目, 知识库; footer NocoBase Studio. This is a proposed product design; small footer 设计示意 · 示例数据. Match native Studio visual language. Do not add manual start-test buttons, create-plan buttons, fake health percentages, or analytics graphs.
Primary request: the Studio PROJECT quality dashboard reached by clicking a project on the all-projects Quality page. Both overall quality and release quality must be clearly visible together. Overall quality is NOT filtered to only unreleased tasks. The release panel is a special evaluation of the upcoming version. Test dimensions are extensible from Skills and actual reports; browser compatibility demonstrates an additional dimension.
Breadcrumb “质量 / Studio”. Main heading “Studio”, small orange badge “存在风险”. Subtitle “负责人 杨洽”. Right quiet green text “持续测试已开启”.
Tabs “质量看板” active, “测试任务”, “质量问题”, “设置”.
Top two horizontally adjacent white panels, overall quality panel taking 55%, release quality 45%.
Left panel heading “整体质量”, prominent text “5 项问题待处理”, small red text “其中 1 项高风险”. Secondary “1 个任务正在测试”. One short muted line “汇总当前有效的测试结果与未解决问题”.
Right panel heading “发布质量”, small chip “当前待发布版本”. Prominent amber text “4 项阻碍发布”. Below three compact counts in one row: “开发任务未完成 1”, “阻塞问题未解决 2”, “必要验证未完成 1”. Bottom right small link “查看阻塞事项”. Make clear these four distinct blocker items are release-specific and not the total 5 quality findings.

Next section “测试维度” with small muted text “随 Skills 与测试报告扩展”. A single compact row of six dimension cells: “功能 / 2 项失败” red; “安全 / 通过” green; “权限 / 1 项高风险” red; “性能 / 通过” green; “UX / 1 项待优化” amber; “浏览器兼容 / 1 项失败” red. Browser compatibility has a small blue “新增” marker. No manual add-dimension button.

Next white panel heading “任务测试情况”. A legible table with wide first column and headers “开发任务”, “功能”, “安全”, “权限”, “性能”, “UX”, “浏览器兼容”, “问题”.
Three rows:
“报告支持按功能筛选” | “通过” | “通过” | “失败” | “通过” | “待优化” | “失败” | “3”
“项目成员批量邀请” | “2 项失败” | “通过” | “通过” | “不涉及” | “通过” | “通过” | “2”
“质量报告指标排序” | “测试中” | “不涉及” | “不涉及” | “不涉及” | “测试中” | “未验证” | “0”.
Color text with small dots, not large pills in every cell. Gray for not applicable or unverified. Note below table “任务完成后，尚未解决的问题仍计入项目质量。”

Bottom white panel heading “未解决问题” with link “全部 5 项”.
Two preview rows:
red “高风险” | “普通成员可查看其他项目报告” | “权限” | orange “阻碍发布” | “待修复”
amber “一般” | “筛选后缺少结果变化提示” | “UX” | gray “可后续处理” | “待优化”.
Keep all sections visible without microscopic text. Avoid huge headings, excessive padding, or overly dense controls. A simple concept image, not an exhaustive dashboard.

Use case: precise-object-edit, UI mockup refinement. Edit the provided NocoBase Studio Quality project-list design. Keep its entire layout, sidebar, typography, project names, table structure, search, selector, dates, and footer. Change ONLY quality verdicts and their supporting detail in the 整体质量 and 发布质量 columns. The design must lead with an explicit evaluation, then a short reason, then supporting counts. Counts alone are not evaluations. Keep all Chinese text readable; preserve the 1568×1003 landscape composition.

In the Studio row:
整体质量: red badge “风险较高”, below it gray text “存在越权风险及功能异常”, then a small subdued line “5 项问题，1 项高风险”.
发布质量: orange badge “暂不建议发布”, below it gray “4 项发布条件尚未满足”.
Keep testing “1 个任务测试中” and updated “5 分钟前”.

供应商管理 row:
整体质量: green badge “质量良好”, below gray “当前验证范围内未发现风险”.
发布质量: green badge “满足发布要求”.
Keep all other cells.

NocoBase 3 row:
整体质量: gray badge “尚未评估”, below gray “必要验证进行中”.
发布质量: amber badge “待验证”, below gray “2 项必要验证未完成”.
Keep all other cells.

客户中心 row:
整体质量: gray badge “尚未评估”.
发布质量: gray badge “尚未评估”.
Keep all other cells.
Adjust row heights slightly if needed but preserve the simple spacious table, no collisions or illegible tiny text. Do not add charts, scores, new components, watermarks, or controls. Preserve footer “设计示意 · 示例数据”.

Use case: precise-object-edit, UI mockup refinement. Edit the provided NocoBase Studio project quality dashboard. Keep its entire composition, sidebar, tabs, bottom dimension row, task matrix and unresolved-issue list UNCHANGED. Change ONLY the two top summary cards and the small badge beside Studio. Preserve crisp Simplified Chinese text and the 1568×1003 landscape canvas.

The two top cards must show “verdict, reason, supporting evidence” rather than just large issue counts.
Header badge beside Studio: “风险较高”.

Left top card, exact hierarchy:
Small title “整体质量”.
Large red verdict “风险较高”.
Normal dark sentence “存在跨项目越权风险，部分功能仍有异常。”
Smaller gray supporting line “5 项待处理问题，其中 1 项高风险”.
Small blue status at the bottom “1 个任务正在测试”.
Do NOT retain the old large number-first heading “5 项问题待处理”. The verdict must be the largest text.

Right top card, exact hierarchy:
Small title “发布质量”, retain small blue chip “当前待发布版本”.
Large amber verdict “暂不建议发布”.
Normal dark sentence “阻塞问题与必要验证尚未完成。”
Small gray supporting line “4 项发布条件尚未满足”.
Below in smaller legible type, retain the three-count breakdown “开发任务 1” | “阻塞问题 2” | “必要验证 1”.
Retain the small link “查看阻塞事项” at bottom right.
Do NOT retain the old large number-first “4 项阻碍发布” heading.

Keep the cards aligned and readable, no overly dense text. Everything below them remains exactly as the input: extensible dimensions including 浏览器兼容, task test matrix, issue list, footer “设计示意 · 示例数据”. Do not invent scores or claim every test has passed.
